content.text:
[settings]
lockfile = true
minimum_release_age = "7d"

[tools]
node = "24.18.0"

awscli = "2.36.13"
fnox = "1.31.1"
git-cliff = "2.13.1"
hk = "1.53.0"
jq = "1.8.2"
lychee = "0.24.2"
1password-cli = "2.38.1"
glab = "1.111.0"

[tools.trivy]
version = "0.72.0"
minimum_release_age = "1d"

[env]
AWS_ENDPOINT_URL = "https://object.storage.eu01.onstackit.cloud"

POSTHOG_CLI_HOST = "https://eu.posthog.com"
POSTHOG_CLI_PROJECT_ID = "118340"

[task_config]
includes = ["scripts"]

[tasks.check]
description = "Every check that has to pass before a commit"
depends = ["static-checks", "test-suite"]

[tasks.static-checks]
description = "Every check that needs no test run"
depends = ["format", "type-check", "lint", "stylelint"]

[tasks.format]
description = "Check formatting with prettier"
run = "npm run --silent format"

[tasks.type-check]
description = "Type-check the project with tsc"
run = "npm run --silent type-check"

[tasks.lint]
description = "Lint TypeScript sources with oxlint"
run = "npm run --silent lint"

[tasks.stylelint]
description = "Lint CSS sources with stylelint"
run = "npm run --silent stylelint"

[tasks.test-suite]
description = "Run the vitest suite"
run = "npm run --silent test"

[tasks.link-check]
description = "Check the external links in the sources and the documentation"
run = 'lychee --no-progress . "src/**/*.ts" "src/**/*.tsx"'

[tasks.check-posthog-schema]
description = "Report whether the generated PostHog schema still matches the project"
run = "fnox exec -- npm run --silent posthog:schema:status"

[tasks.pull-posthog-schema]
description = "Regenerate the typed PostHog schema from the project"
run = "fnox exec -- npm run --silent posthog:schema:pull"

[tasks.build]
description = "Build the widget for the environment selected with MISE_ENV"
run = 'npm run build:${EGR_BUILD_MODE:?no environment selected, use MISE_ENV=staging, production or preview}'

[tasks.publish-assets]
hide = true # Reached through scripts/deploy.sh, which selects the environment first.
description = "Build, verify and upload the widget into the bucket root"
run = ["scripts/check-build-artifacts.sh", "fnox exec --no-defaults -- scripts/upload-asset-build.sh"]
depends = ["build"]

[tasks.publish-preview]
hide = true # Reached through scripts/deploy.sh, which selects the environment first.
description = "Build, verify and upload the standalone preview page"
run = ["scripts/check-build-artifacts.sh", "fnox exec --no-defaults -- scripts/upload-preview-build.sh"]
depends = ["build"]

[tasks.unpublish-preview]
hide = true # Reached through scripts/deploy.sh, which selects the environment first.
description = "Delete the preview from the staging bucket"
run = "fnox exec --no-defaults -- scripts/remove-preview.sh"

[tasks.start]
description = "Serve the widget inside the Familienportal host page snapshot"
depends = ["generate-app-wrapper"]
run = "npm start"

[tasks.audit]
description = "Collection of all audits in our project"
depends = ["audit-licenses", "audit-runtime-vulnerabilities", "audit-secrets"]

[tasks.audit-licenses]
description = "Check dependency licences against ./allowed-licenses"
run = "npm run --silent audit-licenses"

[tasks.audit-runtime-vulnerabilities]
description = "Scans the dependencies that reach the bundle, medium severity and up"
run = "trivy --quiet filesystem . --severity MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 --vex vex.openvex"

[tasks.audit-all-vulnerabilities]
description = "Scans production and dev dependencies with severity from medium to critical"
run = "trivy --quiet filesystem . --include-dev-deps --severity MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 --vex vex.openvex"

[tasks.audit-secrets]
description = "Scan the working tree for committed secrets with trivy"
run = 'trivy --quiet filesystem . --scanners secret --exit-code 1'

[tasks.generate-sbom]
description = "Write the CycloneDX bill of materials"
run = "trivy --quiet filesystem . --include-dev-deps --scanners vuln --format cyclonedx --output sbom.cdx"

[tasks.release-notes]
description = "Render the changelog of the most recent tag to stdout"
run = "git-cliff --latest"
---
